items.title: Disney Taps Adobe as 'Official AI Innovation Partner' Under Multiyear Pact
items.excerpt: Disney and Adobe announced a multiyear alliance making Adobe Disney's 'official AI innovation partner', giving Disney early access to Adobe's latest AI and media tech (Firefly, Firefly Foundry) for its creative teams; timed to Adobe MAX, Nov. 10-12 in Miami.

items.title: Disney Partners With Adobe On AI Tools That Turn Artists' Sketches Into Finished Concept Art
items.excerpt: Under the multiyear alliance Adobe gives Disney Firefly, Firefly Foundry, Premiere, Photoshop and dedicated engineers to build bespoke AI models trained on Disney IP, including tools that turn hand-drawn sketches into fully rendered concept art.
items.note: same story as Variety Disney-Adobe; artist/animation angle

items.title: CAA Wants to Create an AI-Generated Celebrity Advertising Machine
items.excerpt: CAA and Ogilvy launched ECHO, a platform that uses CAA's 'vault' of opted-in clients' scanned likenesses and voices to generate celebrity ads; one shoot of 8-10 assets can be expanded into 30-50 AI variants inside standard post-production tools.

items.title: Framestore Brings Hybrid AI/VFX to Sky's Christmas Campaign
items.excerpt: Framestore built AI tools into its traditional VFX pipeline for Sky's 'That's Christmas Sorted' spot directed by Dave Meyers, using them for previs, character removal and self-animating costumes alongside CG environments.

items.title: Cinematographers' Favorite Festival Is All About AI This Year — but Artists Still Hate the Tech
items.excerpt: IndieWire reports from Camerimage 2026, which gives AI advocates and opponents equal programming time; directors are proving more open to generative tools than cinematographers.
items.note: deprioritized: Camerimage opening carded 11-09; only use if new decisions

items.title: Adobe MAX Kicks Off This Week as Company Shares Stats on Accelerating AI Use
items.excerpt: Ahead of Adobe MAX in Miami, Adobe's Creators' Toolkit Report survey of 2,000+ US creators quantifies how generative AI is speeding up video and design workflows; AI is expected to dominate MAX announcements.

items.title: Adobe Launches 10-Part Masterclass for Creators Led by Dhar Mann, Kinigra Deon and More
items.excerpt: Adobe's 10-part Creator Playbook includes a course by Curious Refuge CEO Caleb Ward on taking an AI-native idea through a full creative pipeline, including a 'Studio Anywhere' approach to AI-generated sets.

items.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Hopes to Tap YouTube Following — and Grimes — for Breakout Moment
items.excerpt: Gossip Goblin creator Zack London's AI-generated anthology 'Gods Don't Give Gifts', produced with Fable and featuring Grimes' voice and likeness, opens Dec. 4 as the first AI-generated film to get a U.S. theatrical release.
items.note: film carded before (Deadline 07 & 10); new = Grimes + Dec 4 theatrical date

items.title: Real-Time Video at Batch Size One
items.excerpt: Runway details how it serves its ~57B-parameter autoregressive video diffusion model in real time for Characters: a new four-frame chunk every 166.7ms at 24 fps per user, running one session across four H100s.

items.title: Original 'Return of the Living Dead' Stars Slam AI-Generated Sequel
items.excerpt: 'Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath', released Oct. 31 by DragonFLIX, is almost entirely AI-generated imagery and dialogue; original stars Linnea Quigley and Beverly Randolph say they appear without having filmed anything and disown it.
items.note: off-list (bloody-disgusting.com): no on-list outlet covered it

items.title: AI로 영상·음악·게임 직접 만든다…'AI 콘텐츠 페스티벌 2026' 12일 개막
items.excerpt: 문체부와 콘진원이 12~14일 서울 코엑스에서 'AI 콘텐츠 페스티벌 2026'을 열어 AI 영상·음악·게임 제작 체험, SBS 가상인간 대화, 콘텐츠 기업 투자유치·사업 협력 프로그램을 선보인다.

items.title: "멍멍이 둘이 할리우드 접수?"…AI 강아지 콤비, 조회수 15억 돌파에 워너브러더스까지 러브콜
items.excerpt: 캐나다 도그팩의 AI 생성 강아지 캐릭터 '골디와 프렌치'가 누적 조회수 15억회를 넘기며 할리우드 연예기획사와 계약하고 워너브러더스 영화 마케팅 캠페인에도 참여했다.

items.title: 최휘영 "AI 파도, 연대의 방식으로 항로 찾는 영화인에 박수"
items.excerpt: 대한민국예술원 영화전에서 AI가 임권택 감독의 영화를 학습해 그의 롱테이크 연출을 따라 만든 단편 '확인'이 처음 공개됐다. 주제는 '임권택 없이 임권택 영화 만들기'.

items.title: Remington Scott to Lead Eros Innovation's New AI Creative Unit
items.excerpt: Eros Innovation launched Eros Imagination, an AI-native unit combining VFX, animation, AI-assisted filmmaking, digital humans, performance capture and virtual production, led by Gollum mocap lead Remington Scott.

items.title: Chomet Denies AI Use In Dior Ad, Cites 'Automated Interpolation'
items.excerpt: Sylvain Chomet and his producer insist the Dior animated short was hand-drawn but acknowledge 'automated interpolation' was used, reopening the line between AI and software-assisted in-betweening.
items.note: Chomet story carded 11-05..11-07; only the 'automated interpolation' admission is new

items.title: The New Cinematic AI Film Workflow (What Actually Works)
items.excerpt: Behind-the-scenes of the AI short 'Planet Hell': Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt driven over MCP by Claude Code and Codex, Gemini 4 Argon as story editor and colorist in DaVinci Resolve, After Effects for fixes - including a model-forced recast.

items.title: New iZotope Photon powered by 12 machine-learning models
items.excerpt: iZotope's Photon uses 12 machine-learning models for stem separation, dialogue denoising and repair aimed at video and film post-production audio.

items.title: 딥브레인AI, 대화만으로 영상 기획부터 편집까지 자동화…'AI스튜디오 5.0' 공개
items.excerpt: 딥브레인AI가 대화나 문서만으로 영상 기획·대본·생성 영상·음성·편집까지 자동화하는 '비디오 에이전트'와 대화형 AI 아바타를 통합한 AI스튜디오 5.0을 출시했다.
